description: Experimental broad-band guidance for a balanced identity LoRA dataset. These values are policy defaults for dataset reasoning, not benchmark-derived facts.

identity_close.label: identity close-up
identity_close.notes: Extreme close-up and close-up identity evidence. Extra examples beyond the soft range should earn their place through view/expression diversity or unusually strong signal.

upper_body.label: medium / upper-body
upper_body.notes: Medium-close, medium, three-quarter, waist and upper-body evidence; intended to carry most balanced identity-LoRA training signal.

full_body.label: full-length
full_body.notes: Full-body evidence is protected strongly when thin, but additional examples should ideally add different facial/body/action geometry rather than duplicate a frontal standing pose.

policy_notes: Preferred shares are broad guidance bands, not exact quotas.
Minimum counts prevent tiny datasets from losing important categories merely because a percentage rounds down.
Soft caps create diminishing returns: very large datasets do not need to preserve a composition percentage forever if extra images add no new evidence.
Coverage count, within-bucket diversity, and representative quality are tracked separately as coverage debt, diversity debt, and quality debt.
Guidance protection means the dataset currently needs the evidence; it does not imply that the protected image itself is high quality.
When spatial/semantic evidence is quarantined or weak for the source analyzer, diversity claims using that evidence are marked unassessed rather than guessed.
Scene/environment diversity is a guidance objective, not an image-quality score; all-indoor or all-outdoor datasets may generalize poorly even if individual images are strong.
Lighting diversity is intentionally softer than environment diversity until illumination is captured as a structured Analyze field.
Acquisition planning prefers images that repay multiple debts simultaneously, such as a clean full-body profile under a lighting/environment condition that is currently thin.

environment.notes: Prefer some meaningful indoor/enclosed and outdoor evidence. These are broad anti-homogeneity floors rather than desired exact percentages.

illumination.notes: Lighting diversity is a soft acquisition preference. Analyze v1 did not request structured lighting, so missing/unknown lighting must not be treated as a real deficit without sufficient evidence.

acquisition_planner.notes: One acquisition should ideally pay multiple debts at once. Donor cost rises when removing an image would erase scarce context evidence.
